_comment: Edit this to point the agent at any site — yours or a client's. Only 'domain' and 'seed_topics' are needed to start; tracked_keywords activates share of voice.
market_context: Fractional product marketing and GTM engineering for B2B SaaS and healthcare AI companies. Buyers are founders, heads of marketing, and GMs who need positioning, launches, and AI-built marketing systems.
_competitors_note: Corrected 2026-07-26 from an actual SERP run. The original guesses (sharebird.com, reforge.com) held 0% across all 8 tracked keywords; these are the domains that actually rank.

_notes.tracked_keywords: Each keyword costs 1 SerpApi credit per run. Free tier is 250/month, so ~60 keywords weekly stays free. Run fetch_serp.py --dry-run to price a set before spending credits.
_notes.competitors: Domains you want share-of-voice tracked against. The report also surfaces whoever actually owns the SERPs, so leave this rough at first and correct it after the first run.
_notes.seed_topics: Inputs to Google Suggest expansion. Broad beats narrow — the point is to discover the long tail you haven't thought of.
